text: It is NOT safe to delete loop/graph_memory.py by itself. C1 establishes it is a real, live dependency of loop/program_db.py (not dead code by any static measure) inside the memory_snapshot branch of validate_event, which is part of program_db.py own declared event schema (memory_snapshot is in ALL_EVENT_TYPES and is a required precondition for proposal_batch/broker_request validation) and has a companion design doc (loop/GRAPH_MEMORY_DESIGN.md). C2+CHK-suite establish that no current code path or test exercises that branch today, so deleting the file causes zero CURRENT test regressions -- but that is a statement about present test coverage, not about the reference being dead. Deleting only loop/graph_memory.py would leave program_db.py with an import that raises ImportError the moment a memory_snapshot event is ever validated, silently converting a dormant-but-functional feature into a broken one for a documented event type. Making that safe requires also removing/repointing the memory_snapshot handling (and the proposal_batch/broker_request dependency on it) in program_db.py -- a larger schema-surgery decision beyond deleting one file, consistent with the prior (unverified-until-now) note in CLAUDE.md that this removal needs surgery judged not worth the risk without it. Verdict: leave loop/graph_memory.py in place; no repo change is justified by this task.
